profile.headline: Software Engineer | Staff Engineer | Dev Lead | Frontend Developer | Full Stack Developer | React Developer | React Native Developer | Mobile Developer | Hybrid Apps Developer
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer with 10 years of experience, including the last 5 years in the United States on TN status, with 3 successful TN applications.

I’m currently based in Mexico and eligible to obtain a new TN visa for a qualifying U.S. position. I do not require H-1B sponsorship, lottery participation, or PERM—only a TN-compliant offer/support letter and the company’s standard immigration coordination.

My background includes React Native, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, hybrid mobile development, Angular, RxJS, JavaScript, PHP, MongoDB, MySQL and modern front-end/back-end frameworks. 


I possess a background in developing scalable applications utilising Agile methodologies and architectural designs, and in optimising application performance while maintaining compliance with accessibility standards. Skilled in creating responsive applications, API-driven systems, and delivering comprehensive solutions throughout the entire software development lifecycle.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained Marriott website pages to enhance the user experience.
Built reusable, responsive, and scalable components based on the Atomic Design methodology.
Integrated and managed data utilising GraphQL APIs and reusable components through Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). 
Optimised application performance, accessibility, and search engine optimisation (SEO).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer | Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Led the implementation of WCAG 2.1 accessibility guidelines, improving usability and ensuring compliance for users with disabilities
Led the migration of mobile applications from Cordova to Capacitor, improving maintainability, performance, and native platform integration
Led the implementation of passwordless authentication across applications, including integration with the OwnID platform
Ensured cross-device and cross-platform compatibility across iOS, Android, and Web platforms, optimizing application performance and user experience
Developed and maintained reusable React components using Ionic, improving scalability, consistency, and code maintainability
Managed complex application state using Redux Toolkit, Redux Persist, and the Context API, while integrating reactive programming patterns with RxJS
Created unit and integration tests using Jest to improve application reliability, stability, and code quality
Maintained and upgraded legacy applications built with React and Cordova, ensuring long-term stability, scalability, and performance optimization
Collaborated closely with designers, QA engineers, and product managers to deliver high-quality, user-centered experiences
Maintained, refactored, and enhanced native mobile codebases in Java (Android) and Swift (iOS) to ensure performance, stability, and scalability
Maintained and supported CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to streamline automated build, testing, and deployment workflows

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer | Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Created and maintained content models and managed content in Contentful
Fetched and managed data from backend services using GraphQL and the Contentful API
Implemented A/B testing experiments using Optimizely
Created and maintained reusable React components following the Atomic Design methodology
Implemented and maintained Storybook as the single source of truth for UI components to ensure modularity and reusability across applications
Responsible for the styling, responsiveness, and overall look and feel of web components using styled-components and styled-system
Monitored and analyzed web performance metrics using SpeedCurve
Implemented GraphQL loaders in Next.js to improve application performance and data-fetching efficiency
Developed unit tests using Jest to ensure code quality and application reliability
Ensured cross-browser and cross-platform compatibility across web applications
Used Postman to test API endpoints and validate response consistency and reliability
Supported and maintained AngularJS modules for an in-house web application
Managed sprint tasks and agile workflows using JIRA and Kanban methodologies
Implemented React Native DevTools and Reactotron for debugging, testing, and application optimization
Managed dynamic form templates and state handling using Formik
Developed gray-box end-to-end automated testing using Detox

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created web-client authentication and router modules
Responsible for style, look, and feel of the web page with SASS that extends CSS with dynamic behavior such as variable, mixing, operations, and functions
Designed angular services to request information from the back end
Developed “pipes” to transform information to display the correct format in the render view
Implemented a final state machine module to improve the flow that is used in the application
Implemented Dependency Injection Pattern to reduce the dependency coupling between classes and in the Front end using Angular
Ensured cross-device and cross-platform compatibility
Participated in the design and implementation of a web application to retire an old application by using the latest web technologies such as Angular, Firebase, Material Design
Migrated Onboarding platform in PHP to Angular from Clarodrive
Migrated various JavaScript libraries such Backbone, Underscore.js and, jQuery to Angular components inside apps supported in the platform
Migrated Angular version (upgrade) from version 5 to version 9
Designed and developed strong services in the backend using NodeJS and Express Framework to provide specific information
Created front-end Single Page Application (SPA) development using React, React-Router and React Hooks implementation to manage the state
Designed and developed different components in React
Fetched data from mongo DB using Mongoose of Node.js
Implemented React DevTools for debugging, testing, and optimization
Designed and developed APIs for a PHP middleware that validates user’s information before request information from the backend
Used Postman to test all endpoints from APIs to check consistency in their responses
Managed code revision history using SourceTree and Bitbucket
Involved in complete SDLC - Requirement Analysis, Development, System and Integration Testing
Worked on an Agile (SCRUM) development team to provide updates to team and project managers

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: Guillermo González Camarena No 1000, Zedec Santa Fe, Álvaro Obregón.
positions.description:
Developed a survey management system using Laravel 5.6 and VueJS v.2 to show a KPI charts board
Designed interface appearance for the survey system
Implemented Vue DevTools for debugging, testing, and optimization
Designed and developed Vue components to re-use inside the application
Implemented Vue-chartjs to create a dashboard view
Implemented Axios library to generate a custom request manager module in the application
Supported modules using Zend Framework for a service operation in-house system
Participated in meetings with the clients to develop the layout and color scheme for the web page and implemented them with the help of PHP, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
Experienced in Installation, integration, and configuration of third-party tools, and content management systems (CodeIgniter, Zend, Laravel)
Worked on pure CSS Flexbox/Grid, Pseudo-classes, and Pseudo components and so on
Worked on Bootstrap to create a User Interface with a responsive design
Implementation of various design patterns, i.e., Factory pattern, Repository Pattern, Singleton Pattern, Dependency Injection Pattern
Worked on cross-browser compatibility and fixed bugs for several browsers
Database administration (MySQL, MongoDB)

Migrated site-wide front-end from HTML to jQuery and Bootstrap
Built client-side validations before submitting them to the backend
Created custom filters and services to reuse them throughout the application
Ensured each element on the page was created as a template to maintain the modularity and make it reusable for other fields in different states

Documented changes and updates on the application

Participated in the complete SDLC process and used PHP to develop website functionality
